message.text:
Two memo handlers broadcast live events: `CreateMemo` in `memo_service.go` emits `SSEEventMemoCreated`, and `DeleteMemo` in `memo_service.go` emits `SSEEventMemoDeleted`.

`CreateMemoComment` in `memo_service_comments.go` emits `SSEEventMemoCommentCreated`. `UpdateMemo` via `memo_update_helpers.go` emits `SSEEventMemoUpdated`. Reactions also broadcast but are not memo handlers.

message.text:
The memo handlers are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, and DeleteMemo in memo_service.go. They broadcast live events through the hub.

CreateMemoComment in memo_service_comments.go also broadcasts directly. Attachment and relation setters in memo_attachment_service.go and memo_relation_service.go broadcast memo.updated events. Reactions are excluded because they are not memo handlers.

message.text:
The memo handlers broadcasting through the hub are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations. Reaction handlers also broadcast, but they are not memo handlers.

The mechanism is SSE. The hub is implemented in server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go.

q20.
SSE; server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations

The hub is `SSEHub` in `sse_hub.go`; clients connect via `GET /api/v1/sse` in `sse_handler.go`. Those memo handlers call `SSEHub.Broadcast` (UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations go through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `memo_update_helpers.go`). Reaction handlers also broadcast, but they are not memo RPCs.
